<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex02032024-10-1509-38-46" status="unreviewed">de la dang po ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5611">'bum pa</rs> ltar na | rnam bshad mdzad ces brjod do | 
 <mentioned>gang gi zhe na</mentioned> | bstan chos chen po 'di'o | 
 <mentioned>gang la brten nas ce na | </mentioned>
 mi pham mgon la gsan nas so || <mentioned>gang gis ce na | </mentioned>
 'phags pa zhes pa'o || 
 de yon tan gyi khyad par ci dang ldan ce na | de'i mtshan don dang ldan pa yin pas rang dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa brjod la | de yang rgyu dang bcas par brjod do || 
 rang gi don ni mthong bas spang bar bya ba'i nyon mongs pa spangs pas sdig to mi dge ba'i chos las ring du bsrings te spang bas 'phags pa ste spangs pa dang | thogs shing chags pa med pa'i de kho na'i ye shes mnga' bas thogs med de ye shes so || 
 gzhan don ni nyid kyis gzigs pa'i lam bstan pas gzhan sdug bsngal dang de'i rgyu las skyob pas skyob nyid do | ga nas gcig tu 'gro ba'i sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje'i chags pa goms pa ni ba gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu'o || 'jig rten chos mchog man chad du dmigs pa'am chags pa med pa'i shes rab goms pa ni rang don gyi rgyu'o || 
 mi pham pa ni dgra'am yon tan gyi bde bgo skal gyis so || des na spangs pa dang ye shes te rang don no || mgon po ni thugs rjes gzhan gyi don mdzad pas na gzhan don no || de la gsan pa ni bar du dus byas te dga' | skye gnas gcig <lb edRef="inst:6286" n="300"/> | rgyas 'bring bsam pa ldan du'o | bring gsum gyi don rgya che ba dang zab pa gsal bar byed pas bstan bcos chen po'o || </seg></TEI>
